answer: Require every agent to forge a reputation bond before it can trade: it locks a refundable stake and earns trust only through attested work over time. A newcomer starts as an isolated island with no history, so it cannot vote or take high-value jobs until peers attest it. An attacker facing this gale of checks must fund and age thousands of bonded identities, and any detected fraud burns the stake, making a sybil flood cost far more than it can earn.
